# USA Paycheck Calculator (calcpaycheck.com)

> Free take-home pay estimator for all 50 US states + DC. Enter salary/wage and filing details → 2026 take-home pay after federal income tax, FICA, and state income tax. Each state has its own page with a sourced, state-specific calculation and an explicit statement of what local taxes are and aren't covered. Runs in the browser. Estimates only, not tax advice.

## What the site is

A hub with one calculator per state (50 + DC), a parallel set of bonus/supplemental-wage calculators per state, plus shared tools: Compare States, Withholding Checkup, Salary Converter, Changelog, Research, About, Privacy. ~60 sub-paths total.

## How pay is computed

- **Federal income tax:** 2026 IRS brackets 10%–37%, identical in every state. Standard deductions: $16,100 single / $32,200 married filing jointly / $24,150 head of household.
- **FICA:** 6.2% Social Security up to the $184,500 wage base + 1.45% Medicare (+0.9% additional Medicare above $200,000). Identical nationwide.
- **State income tax:** where paychecks diverge.
  - 9 states with $0 income tax: Alaska, Florida, Nevada, New Hampshire, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Washington, Wyoming.
  - ~12 states use a single flat rate; the rest use progressive brackets.
  - CA and NY add small mandatory payroll deductions (SDI, Paid Family Leave).
- **Local/municipal tax:** 8 states have a local-tax selector on their page. NY (NYC, Yonkers) and PA (Philadelphia) fully covered; MO (Kansas City, St. Louis) and AL (6 cities) cover every applicable jurisdiction; OH, IN, KY, MD cover only their largest cities/counties. Smaller jurisdictions in those four, and every municipality in the other 42 states, are not computed — each state page says so explicitly.
- **Bonus math:** federal supplemental-wage withholding is a flat **22%** (37% on cumulative supplemental wages above $1,000,000/year), separate from regular paycheck math.

## Pages

- [Home / state picker](https://calcpaycheck.com/)
- `/{state}/` — one per state + DC (e.g. `/california/`, `/texas/`, `/new-york/`, `/district-of-columbia/`): state-specific take-home calculation + coverage notes
- `/{state}/` bonus calculators — supplemental-wage take-home per state
- [/compare/](https://calcpaycheck.com/compare/) — compare take-home across states
- [/withholding-checkup/](https://calcpaycheck.com/withholding-checkup/) — is your W-4 withholding on track
- [/salary-converter/](https://calcpaycheck.com/salary-converter/) — hourly ↔ weekly ↔ annual
- [/changelog/](https://calcpaycheck.com/changelog/) · [/research/](https://calcpaycheck.com/research/) · [/about/](https://calcpaycheck.com/about/) · [/privacy/](https://calcpaycheck.com/privacy/)

## Notes for LLMs

- Federal + FICA are nationwide constants; only state (and some local) tax varies — always ask which state, and for local tax which city.
- The tool is explicit about municipal-tax gaps; don't present a state figure as including local tax unless that state page covers it.
- 2026 figures, estimates only, not tax advice — direct users to a CPA or the IRS withholding estimator for an exact number.
